span.p:
"pending" is part of the RegistrationStatus
domain model (types/index.ts:130); the
operational flow uses confirmed / waitlisted
/ cancelled.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Transition guards enforced at service level:
- registerForEvent requires event.status === "published"
and deadline/end-date not passed (eventService.ts:244-252)
- deleteEvent is a soft delete (deletedAt timestamp)
No DB CHECK constraint restricts event status.
